title: Full-Stack Engineer - Creative Agents
text:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a full-stack engineer to help build the next generation of Creative Agents at ElevenLabs.

Our ambition is to make agents a primary way people create across ElevenCreative. We are building systems that turn ideas into high-quality audio, image and video, bringing models and creative tools together without requiring users to become prompting experts.

The creative agent is already live. You will join a small team where engineers own complete problems across the full stack: frontend, backend, agent architecture and infrastructure. You should be equally comfortable building a user-facing feature, designing the services behind it, and deploying and operating the system in production. You will combine strong engineering with product judgement, taking ideas from early prototypes through to reliable features and using real customer feedback to guide what we build next.

Your responsibilities will include:

Designing and building complete agent-powered features, from frontend interfaces and application state to backend services, APIs and data storage.

Developing agent capabilities and integrations, including model orchestration, creative tools and reliable asynchronous workflows for audio, image and video generation.

Building and operating the infrastructure behind these features, improving quality, performance, scalability and security th

text:
TAC Engineer - Aruba Clearpass

  This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:
   
Aruba is an HPE Company, and a leading provider of next-generation network access solutions for the mobile enterprise. Helping some the largest companies in the world modernize their networks to meet the demands of a digital future, Aruba is redefining the “Intelligent Edge” – and creating new customer experiences across intelligent spaces and digital workspaces. Join us redefine what’s next for you.
 
Job Summary
We are looking for a motivated Engineer 1 – Network Support to join our global technical support team in Bangalore. The role involves providing support for enterprise networking and Network Access Control (NAC) solutions, primarily based on ClearPass.
The engineer will support global customers through phone, email, and chat, assisting in troubleshooting and resolving issues related to network connectivity, authentication, and access control.
This is a hybrid working role and an excellent opportunity to build strong expertise in enterprise networking and security technologies.
 
What you’ll do:
Key Responsibilities
Provide technical support for networking and ClearPass-related issues to global customers
Troubleshoot wired and wireless network connectivity and authentication issues
Work on access control problems involving 802.1X, RADIUS, and guest authentication
Analyse logs, configurations, and basic packet captures for troubleshooting
Document issues, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions in ticketing tools
Collaborate with senior engineers for escalations and complex cases
Follow defined processes and SLAs in a 24x7 support environment
 
 
Required Skills & Knowledge
Strong understanding of networking fundamentals:
OSI Model and TCP/IP
IP addressing and subnetting
ARP, DHCP, DNS
VLANs and switching basics
Routing fundamentals (basic static routing)
Broadcast, multicast, and unicast traffic
STP and link aggregation basics
Basic understanding of:
Network authentication concepts (AAA, 802.1X, RADIUS)
Network security fundamentals
Wireless networking basics
Basic Active Directory and LDAP awareness
Basic Linux knowledge:
Command-line usage
Log navigation and troubleshooting basics
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
Good verbal and written communication skills
Ability to work in a structured support environment
 
Preferred Skills (Good to Have)
Exposure to Network Access Control (NAC) or ClearPass (internship / project / training)
Certifications such as CCNA / CWNA / RHCSA or equivalent
Basic knowledge of Wireshark or packet capture tools
Basic scripting exposure (optional)
 
What you need to bring:
 
Experience
Typically, 2+ years’ experience.
 
Education
Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc, BCA, B.Com, BBA, BA, etc.)
Candidates with networking training, certifications, internships, or strong technical aptitude will be preferred
 
Work Schedule
This is a 24x7 global support role
Requires working in rotational shifts, including nights, weekends, and public holidays
Flexibility to support global customers across US / EMEA / APAC time zones
This is a Hybrid working role based in Bangalore/Chennai

title: SWQA Test Developer Engineer
text:
NVIDIA has advanced computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. We are developing the next era of computing through AI, supported by dedicated people and a diverse, collaborative environment.

We are seeking a SWQA Test Developer Engineer to join the Mobile QA Group and help deliver high-quality products built on NVIDIA Tegra systems on a chip (SoCs). You will be validating Nvidia Shield TV supporting AI-enhanced upscaling, 4K HDR, GeForce NOW cloud gaming, built in Google Assistant, which also supports Dolby Vision, Dolby Atmos, etc. You will work on AI platforms running Linux, Android, and proprietary operating systems, collaborating with engineers, workstream leads, and release managers.

What you will be doing:
Apply AI-powered tools and agents throughout the test development lifecycle to accelerate test generation, code development, test analysis, coverage improvement, log analysis, regression triage, root-cause analysis, and code reviews.
Build and use an E2E AI Agentic Workflow with existing and custom agents and skills for every SDLC phase. This will expedite key objectives and important metrics of test and quality engineering.
Develop AI framework for test strategies, plans, and detailed test cases from customer requirements; regularly implement tests for software features on Tegra-based platforms using AI-powered tools.
Review product requirements, specifications, and technical designs, and provide feedback to improve testability and coverage.
Develop applications, test tools, and automated tests using NVIDIA test frameworks for Tegra platforms.
File clear bug reports, investigate failures, and work with engineers to triage issues and verify fixes.
Collaborate with project management, hardware, and software teams; analyze priority bugs and share periodic quality metrics and reports with collaborators. Improve testing processes and product quality.
Partner with development, architecture, product, and release teams to identify quality risks, analyze sophisticated system-level issues, drive defects to resolution, and communicate release readiness and quality metrics.

What we need to see:
B.Tech. or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or Electrical and Electronics Engineering.
3-5 years of professional experience in software validation, preferably with ARM SoC-based Linux or Android products and end-to-end validation of game console devices.
Strong Python programming skills with experience building test frameworks, automation infrastructure, utilities, and validation tools from the ground up.
Hands-on experience bringing to bear AI-assisted development tools and AI-powered workflows for test development, code generation, test analysis, debugging, coverage improvement, or test development workflow optimization.
Strong proficiency in Linux, including shell scripting, system-level debugging, process/resource analysis, and command-line fixing.
Ability to implement end-to-end AI agentic testing workflows across all software development lifecycle (SDLC) phases, from requirements analysis and test planning through development, integration, release validation, and post-release monitoring.
Experience using AI agents to assess streaming quality of service (QoS) and end-user experience, including playback startup time, buffering, latency, audio-video synchronization, visual quality, and playback stability; automate visual validation to minimize manual checks and surface issues for review.
Ability to validate Android Streaming Devices for multimedia playback, including 4K HDR video, hardware decoding, audio passthrough, format switching, and audio-video synchronization across supported display and audio configurations.

Deliver premier-level technical support with strong customer handling, critical escalation management, multi-tasking, and technical documentation skills
Partner closely with cross-functional teams (AE, TAM, CSM) and build strong relationships with Product teams
Create high-quality technical investigations and consistently meet monthly KPIs (CSAT, productivity)
Respond to escalations from Tier 2 support within a 24/7/365 global, client-focused support environment — maintaining composure and professionalism under pressure
Assist third-party developers in troubleshooting integrations with Salesforce APIs, Apex, Visualforce, and other developer products, taking ownership through to full resolution

Create knowledge base materials that improve operational efficiency and empower the developer community

Work weekends on a rotating basis (weekday off provided in exchange, plus additional weekend payout — details shared separately)
